name: wordpress-git-sync
description: Guarded two-way Git and WordPress synchronization with canonical managed objects, atomic compare-and-swap, migration tooling, and operator runbooks.

interface.shortDescription: Guarded Git and WordPress content synchronization.
interface.longDescription: A reviewed WordPress synchronization package with stable managed-object identities, deterministic canonical JSON and hashes, a server-side atomic compare-and-swap runtime, a secret-safe wp-content-sync CLI, content and Site Editor adapters, manifest media, ACF extension contracts, reviewed GitHub automation, adoption techniques, and rollback-first operator runbooks.
defaultPrompt: Use $wordpress-git-sync-management to inspect this project and produce a dry-run migration plan.
Use $wordpress-git-sync-management to reconcile managed WordPress content without overwriting drift.
